title: OLS Prime: code and records of "How Often Do Look-Ahead Detectors Catch a Leak? A Pre-Registered Benchmark on Crypto Market Bars"
description:
OLS Prime is a from-scratch decision model whose attention is ordinary least squares, with a memory (Matrix) of regression sufficient statistics. This archive holds its code (Rust and Python), its pre-registered protocol and hypotheses, its audit records and the LaTeX source of the paper.

The paper measures look-ahead leak detectors (future invariance, truncation, re-tiling, a two-run perturbation detector and a future-shuffle twin) on a generated population of temporal leaks, with honest twins, on daily BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT bars.

The market data (Binance Vision, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) are not included. The leak corpus's outputs are not included either: they derive from those data. The code, the seeds and the SHA-256 digests recorded in docs/PROTOCOL.md regenerate them byte for byte.
